title: Arctic Aurora Lodge: Trapper's Night
infoTitle: ARCTIC AURORA LODGE · HOW IT PLAYS

text.idle: THE SKY IS QUIET. PLACE A BET

buys.name: Aurora Muse
buys.text: Three FS embers drop at once and the aurora starts 10 free spins. Every spin it lights one symbol: that symbol wins from only 5 tiles and its ice blocks count double.
buys.confirmText: AURORA MUSE: three FS land, then 10 free spins. Each spin one symbol is lit: it wins from 5 tiles and its blocks count double.

buys.name: Aurora Sweep
buys.text: Four Aurora Gems freeze the screen into a sheet of ice. Glowing bands melt it row by row and every cell they cross pays more.
buys.confirmText: AURORA SWEEP: four Aurora Gems land, then at least 4 bands of light sweep a 5x5 ice sheet. Cells crossed by several bands pay x2, x3 and more.

chips: THE AURORA LIGHTS ONE SYMBOL EVERY SPIN

fever.name: Northern Lights
fever.text: Pay 2x per spin: more giant ice blocks land and the FS embers and Aurora Gems come about 1.5 times as often. Stays on until you switch it off.
fever.onMsg: NORTHERN LIGHTS ON. TOTAL BET x2
